data.name: BeebleSwitchXVideoEdit
data.description: Edit a video with Beeble SwitchX. Switches anything in the scene (background, lighting, costume) while preserving the original subject's pixels and motion. Provide a reference image and/or text prompt to describe the new look. Max 240 frames, max ~2.77MP per frame.

input_details.name: prompt
input_details.tooltip: Text description of the desired output (max 2000 chars). At least one of 'prompt' or 'reference_image' is required.

input_details.name: alpha_mode
input_details.tooltip: Controls how SwitchX decides what to keep vs. regenerate. 'auto' isolates the main subject automatically. 'fill' regenerates the entire frame while preserving geometry. 'select' propagates a first-frame keyframe across the clip. 'custom' uses a per-frame alpha matte you provide.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `alpha_mode`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `alpha_mode.`, e.g. `alpha_mode.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `alpha_mode.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: alpha_mode.alpha_keyframe
input_details.tooltip: First-frame keyframe mask. Beeble propagates this across the video.

input_details.name: alpha_mode.alpha_mask
input_details.tooltip: Per-frame grayscale mask covering the entire video. Must have the same frame count as the source. Connect a MASK output from SAM3_TrackToMask or similar.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

input_details.name: reference_image
input_details.tooltip: Reference image whose look (background, lighting, costume) the result should adopt. At least one of 'reference_image' or 'prompt' is required.
